registered_before: the complete 180-case blind state-envelope summary is inspected. Disclosure: early partial records (a few runs of the direct N -> N^2+ and molecular N2^2+ metrics) had been seen in the session log; no summary, maximum or range over the full envelope had been computed.

rule.threshold_between_lower_and_upper: PROMOTE AS AN UNCERTAINTY VARIANT: omission has not been shown harmless, so the uncertainty survives into validation as a chemistry variant. This does not assert the upper-envelope physics.

applies_to: every omitted-process verdict under n2_completeness_audit_v1, using its thresholds (F_P 1 %, F_ion 1 %, F_S_s 5 %) and domains; bounds are taken over all evaluated nuisance choices (operating point, transport candidate, chemistry configuration).
robustness: If a verdict changes with transport or chemistry nuisance choice, the uncertainty belongs in the validation set (treated as the between-bounds case).

model_requirements_on_promotion.molecular_N2_Z2plus: model both N2 + e -> N2^2+ + 3e and N2+ + e -> N2^2+ + 2e; N2 max_charge = 2; verify HallThruster species-energy derivation (a one-to-one N2+ -> N2^2+ link is required)
model_requirements_on_promotion.direct_N_to_N_Z2plus: if promoted, nominal chemistry, with the Hahn-Muller-Savin semi-empirical uncertainty carried as a sensitivity
